queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Firefox Nightly' AND publisher = 'Mozilla Corporation';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Firefox Nightly' AND publisher = 'Mozilla Corporation' AND version_compare(version, '161.2610.3021.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'firefox.exe');
